messages:
liz: FYI FortuneHealth wants a single commercial commit that covers API + Optimize + Console add-ons for a 3-month POC. They estimated ~200M tokens/mo. Asking for ~20% off if we bundle. Can we do this and what approvals do we need?

omar-se: Quick clarifying q — is the 200M tokens/mo steady during POC or peak? Also will they need dedicated capacity for latency-sensitive demos? :eyes:

liz: They said steady-ish but want ability to burst on demo days. Latency matters for their clinician-facing UI.

kevin: From sales side — 3-month POC + single commit sounds fine but need Deal Desk sign-off on cross-product discounting. Also need clear success metrics to avoid free-runs.

anna-fin: Pricing floor note: for bundled discounts >15% we need finance review and a signed commit. 20% would be exceptional but possible with a clear commit and ARR pathway.

dealdesk-bot: @here Please fill out Deal Desk intake (link) with proposed SKUs, list price, requested discount, and term. Attach the customer POC SOW.

claire-sdr: I can push the SOW today. Security/Qs might slow them — they asked for SOC2 and custom data residency. Anyone owns the security checklist? :question:

eng-ml-oncall: Re: infra — for POC we can do Hosted with a short-lived Dedicated burst. That keeps latency tight and limits ops. Recommendation: use Dedicated pool for demo windows + hosted routing otherwise. Example configs: ```
commit: 3 months
capacity: dedicated-burst (2 x V100 equiv during demo)
rate-limit: 10rps per clinician
```

omar-se: Also recommend enabling prefix KV cache and light quantization to cut token cost for Optimize jobs. That reduces effective cost during evaluation.

kevin: I want a quick price sketch to put in intake. Anna — can you give a packaged SKU with 15% and one exceptional SKU at 20% that requires finance-approver signoff?

anna-fin: Yes. I'll draft two lines: (A) Bundle-Basic: API + Optimize + Console add-ons — 15% off list, auto-applies with 3mo commit; (B) Bundle-PRO: 20% off if customer signs a 3mo commit + LOE to migrate to Dedicated later and provides security attestations. I need the expected ARR post-POC to justify.

liz: They indicated likely move to annual in Q3 if POC succeeds — rough ARR estimate $120k/yr.

finance-approver: If ARR path is $120k and legal ok with the SOW, I can greenlight the 20% on a case-by-case with Deal Desk's summary and sec attestation.

kevin: Great — I'll populate the intake with the two SKUs, attach SOW, and mark security blockers. tagging @dealdesk-bot when done. :thumbsup:

claire-sdr: Done — intake submitted. Mentioned SOC2 + data residency request.

dealdesk-bot: Intake received. Routing to deal-desk for review. Expect response within 48 hours.

liz: Thanks team. Next actions: anna to post SKUs in intake, eng-ml-oncall to confirm the dedicated burst config and cost delta, finance-approver to confirm exception once intake has ARR and sec attest. I'll keep FortuneHealth updated on timeline.

omar-se: I'll prepare a short runbook for demo days (env prep + cache warm).
